description: This file defines an interface and a class for creating MySQL database connections. The class, MySqlConnectionFactory, constructs connection strings based on environment variables or configuration options, and provides a method to establish connections to a MySQL database.

classes.name: IMySqlConnectionFactory
classes.description: Interface defining a factory method for creating database connections.

classes.name: MySqlConnectionFactory
classes.description: Sealed class implementing the factory interface, responsible for generating MySQL database connections using configuration options.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MySqlConnection using configuration-derived connection string.

methods.name: TryParsePort
methods.description: Parses a string into an integer port number, returns null if parsing fails.

methods.name: ParseMysqlUrl
methods.description: Parses a MySQL URL to extract host, port, and database name.
